name: EH3D-PROJECT-PASSPORT
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. Technical passport of a project: a Rust library and command line that read a passport (a JSON file whose sections are always written) with the tools and versions, the input and output files with their SHA-256, the results of the checks, the limitations and the pending decisions, find bad hashes, unsafe paths, duplicates and tools without a version, print the hash of the canonical content, compare the passport with the files of a folder (only read) and compare two passports. It has only run on data made by its own tests; the generator from a project, the rebuilding of the manufacturing files and the signature are not written.
